{{Quote|It's a big planet, Scuz. I've got to find the target's ship.|Gyran|<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>}}
'''Scuz''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was part of [[Gyran]]'s team of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. Scuz was part of the team that Gyran led to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] to retrieve the [[Barani List]].<ref name="SSR" />
